requiredFindings.problem: Graph completeness accounts retained partitions but does not establish that they cover every expected imports source. This can make an incompletely examined graph pass.

evidence.detail: The four conditions require an available imports binding, pairing and sufficiency for every retained exact-rung scope, at least one scope per vertex universe, and complete file-rule population. None compares the scopes' source-subject union to the expected imports symbol census or requires that census itself to be complete.

Imports inventories have kind symbol; file-rule population is derived only from relevant kind=file inventories. Scope subjects may be a subset of inventory rows. Complete file enumeration therefore does not close the independently expected symbol/importer population.

Missing expected source subjects make the native account incomplete even if all returned Coverage records are complete. This is an admitted semantic partial outcome, with no invented native carrier. The independent execution deficiency is enforced for required cells; a lawful required=false imports cell does not supply that fallback.

One available U has complete file rows a.ts and b.ts and complete imports symbol rows A and B, mapped to those paths. Its optional imports cell returns a single exact imports/resolved-target scope covering A, paired to sufficient complete Coverage, with no facts or unresolved edges. B is not covered. The execution account truthfully remains incomplete/partial, but creates no required execution deficiency. All of 2.5(a)-(d) nevertheless hold, both file predicates become false, and the pack passes while B's imports have not been examined. This is a contract counterexample, not an executed fixture.

requiredFindings.fix: Require completeness of the expected imports source-symbol census at every owed universe extent and exact-id coverage of every expected source by the returned exact imports/resolved-target scopes, in addition to the existing all-partition pairing and sufficiency checks. Retain a blocking population-unknown cause for an incomplete/unavailable source census and uncovered-expected-source-subject for a known uncovered source, using existing carrier rules without manufacturing provider-unavailable. This requirement must hold independently of the cell's required flag. Add I1-L/I1-b2 discriminating cases for a complete subset partition omitting another expected importer, partial symbol census with complete file population, complete broad partitions covering several importers, and complete-empty source populations.

requiredFindings.problem: The in-place proof3/program-predicate enum widening is not authorized while the proposal expressly leaves the identity law unchanged.

evidence.detail: The identity schemas are closed authoritative records; proof-bundle/proof3 is an identity domain. IE:213-214 requires new identifier majors and reviewed migration for schema/domain changes. The sentence is not qualified to finding-key2 changes or to changes that reinterpret previously valid bytes.

The proposal extends two closed operation enums, including the proof-bundle predicateProofs domain and the schemaVersion=2 program-predicate record, while retaining their existing major dispatch and declaring IE unchanged. The accepted record grammar therefore changes, even though existing instances preserve their meaning.

COMP:7 permits unchanged ancestor record shapes to retain their domains when committed parameter/schema values change. That does not grant an exception for changing those records' own closed accepted operation vocabulary. The identity schema's major law likewise distinguishes changed output domains from unchanged ancestors.

Backward-compatible meanings and older readers' refusal are useful compatibility properties, but neither supplies the reviewed migration or an explicit amendment to IE:213-214. Its placement after fingerprint prose is insufficient to silently narrow its unqualified schema/domain rule.

requiredFindings.fix: Flip LD-3 to explicit new majors and a reviewed migration/dispatch plan for the affected identity records, retaining unchanged ancestors where COMP:7 permits it, and update I1-L, I1-a, pack pins and downstream joins consistently. If the lead instead chooses additive enum extension under existing majors, I1-L must explicitly include a narrowly scoped identity-law successor that authorizes it and defines compatibility/admission behavior; remove the claim that unchanged IE already permits it. Review that amendment rather than relying on paragraph placement.

requiredFindings.problem: Population-only incompleteness has no atom-cause derivation, so a valid partial file inventory can reach the stated host-invariant refusal instead of a semantic indeterminate result.

evidence.detail: Condition (d), complete rule population, is one of the four necessary conditions of the atom's graph-completeness result. It explicitly says the op does not restate composition's population deficiency.

A selected subject outside known cyclic components is indeterminate when graph completeness fails. But the only specified causes are failures of (a)-(c) and uncertain edges. An empty cause set is then declared a host-invariant defect and the value must not be emitted.

Partial inventories retaining known rows are lawful semantic inputs. Composition independently derives an enumeration deficiency and indeterminate gating population; ordinary partial outcomes are expressly outside the operational fault vocabulary.

A partial file inventory retains a.ts while other extent paths remain unseen. Imports binding, complete imports-symbol inventory, every returned scope and sufficient Coverage are all present, with no facts, uncertain edges or cycles. At a.ts, (a)-(c) succeed and (d) alone fails. The table yields indeterminate, but the specified atom causes are empty. Composition's independent enumeration deficiency cannot prevent the earlier stated host-invariant refusal. No fixture was executed.

requiredFindings.fix: Either define the existing blocking native population-unknown cause for failure of (d), retaining the real inventory/enumeration provenance and owner carriers, or keep file-rule population exclusively in composition and remove (d) from the atom's completeness/value decision. In either case a lawful partial file inventory must produce the existing semantic indeterminate rule outcome rather than a host-invariant fault. Add a population-only partial-file case with otherwise complete imports evidence to I1-L and I1-b2.

nonBlockingObservations.observation: The admitted-SCC semantics and the documented possibility of later component merging support the chosen transient representative. The truth-table explanation only proves persistence of a cycle, not persistence of its least-member representative.
nonBlockingObservations.recommendation: Say that true identifies the representative of the current admitted component. Adding edges can merge it with an earlier-path component and make the former representative false; avoid claiming monotonicity of the whole representative proposition.

nonBlockingObservations.observation: The authoritative detailed unit breakdown makes I1-b2 depend on I1-b1. The proposal's short order summary instead lists only I1-a -> I1-b2.
nonBlockingObservations.recommendation: Make the short summary include I1-b1 -> I1-b2 so the two dependency presentations agree.

nonBlockingObservations.observation: LD-10 is explicitly deferred to the C law. A distinct selected kind=detector closure is the right emission binding, but a signed core manifest cannot automatically be reused for an arbitrary one-document detector tree.
nonBlockingObservations.evidence: IE:272-278 requires the admitted manifest's verified role/namespace and selected component/tree/platform joins. COMP:9 forbids a provider/evaluator substitute and undocumented closure-to-contribution inference; WS:277-281 requires explicit contribution/closure/major agreement.
nonBlockingObservations.recommendation: C2/C4 must define and review the host-derived detector tree's exact signed-core provenance and component/role joins, retain its bytes and descriptor, and select it in Plan. Treat LD-10 as a recommendation, not a completed closure-admission law.
